title: Equity Accounting Note — The Dividend Estimate behind the Dividend Cushion on Class H Preferred Stock Purchases, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The dividend cushion on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding is the cushion quarters times the cushion dividend estimate, and it is taken off the holding room when the member buys, so that coming reinvested dividends fit under the largest balance a member may hold.

## The cushion dividend estimate

The cushion dividend estimate depends on the holding's latest dividend entries:

- when a dividend-reversal entry (subscription cancelled with nothing paid out) is dated on or after the latest reinvested dividend and a reinvested dividend is dated within the last 6 whole months, the estimate is the latest reinvested dividend less that reversal;
- when no reinvested dividend is dated within the last 6 whole months, the estimate is the present shares times the declared annual dividend rate of Class H Preferred Stock divided by 400;
- otherwise the estimate is the latest reinvested dividend.

## Terms used

- **Latest reinvested dividend**: the reinvested dividend entry with the latest effective date on the holding.
- **Dividend-reversal entry**: a retirement entry recorded with the reason subscription cancelled and no payment method, nothing being paid out; "that reversal" is the latest such entry.
- **Present shares**: purchases plus reinvested dividends less retirements.
- **Declared annual dividend rate**: the rate in the class schedule of dividend terms (4.25 percent for Class H Preferred Stock).
- The months are whole calendar months counted back from today.

## Cases (hypothetical holdings)

| Latest dividend entries | Estimate |
|---|---|
| Reinvested dividend 3,200.00 dated 15 July 2026; reversal 132.54 dated 20 July 2026; today in August 2026 | 3,200.00 less 132.54 gives 3,067.46 |
| No reinvested dividend in the last 6 whole months; present shares 600,000.00 | 600,000.00 times 4.25 divided by 400 gives 6,375.00 |
| Reinvested dividend 3,200.00 dated 15 July 2026; no reversal on or after it | 3,200.00 |

**Hypothetical cushion.** A holding with 3 cushion quarters and an estimate of 3,067.46 has a dividend cushion of 9,202.38 taken off its holding room.
